title: api-json-compact/1
description: The compact form of the SysML v2 API JSON element array that Convert writes under the convert_compact capability. See api-json-compact.md for the rules that expand it to the element array.

ids.description: The id table. A handle is an index into it.

elementCount.description: ids[0 .. elementCount) are the written elements, in order. It never exceeds the table's length.

elementIdsAreIds.description: Present only when every element's elementId is its @id, in which case no element writes it.

referenceKeys.description: Keys whose references are bare handles. None of them carries a number.

element.description: An element: its @type, then its properties. It carries no @id; element i has the id ids[i].

value.description: A property value: a scalar, a bare handle under a reference key, an {"@id": handle} or {"@ref": name} object, or an array of them.
